Then, we pour wet plaster into the mould.

HOW WE MAKE A COPY
Then, we pour wet plaster into the mould.

Last, we paint the copy until it looks just like old stone.

lines.junior: A yellow helmet, just like the man Pia saw!
lines.master: A yellow helmet, exactly like the man Pia saw!

lines.rookie: Oh! Professor Aldo came on Tuesday, too.
lines.junior: Oh! And Professor Aldo came on Tuesday, too.
lines.master: Oh! Now I remember: Professor Aldo came on Tuesday, too.
